title: From the top 10 departments (excluding Political Science) with the highest
question: From the top 10 departments (excluding Political Science) with the highest range in enrolled students for their offered subjects (considering only degree-granting departments and subjects with more than 0 enrolled students), display each department's name, average, range, and variance of enrolled students, the minimum number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED, the average total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY, and the subject with the highest enrollment in LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED for that department (including the subject title and number of enrolled students), where the number of enrolled students in TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED is at least 0 or the total units in SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY are between 1 and 21. Order the results by enrollment range descending and limit to 10 departments. Do not return any rounded answers.

access_trace.sql:
WITH dept_base AS (
  SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
  FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT d
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
),
so_stats AS (
  SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
         MAX(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range,
         AVG(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_avg,
         VARIANCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_var
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED so
  JOIN dept_base db ON so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
  GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
tip_stats AS (
  SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
         MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_tip_enrolled
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t
  JOIN dept_base db ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
sos_stats AS (
  SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
         AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  JOIN dept_base db ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
lib_top AS (
  SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE,
         l.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title,
         l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrolled,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn
  FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l
  JOIN dept_base db ON l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE
),
lib_top_final AS (
  SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, top_subject_title, top_subject_enrolled
  FROM lib_top
  WHERE rn = 1
),
combined AS (
  SELECT db.DEPARTMENT_CODE,
         db.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
         ss.enrollment_range,
         ss.enrollment_avg,
         ss.enrollment_var,
         ts.min_tip_enrolled,
         sss.avg_total_units,
         lt.top_subject_title,
         lt.top_subject_enrolled
  FROM dept_base db
  JOIN so_stats ss ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN tip_stats ts ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN sos_stats sss ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
  LEFT JOIN lib_top_final lt ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
)
SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
       c.enrollment_avg,
       c.enrollment_range,
       c.enrollment_var,
       c.min_tip_enrolled,
       c.avg_total_units,
       c.top_subject_title,
       c.top_subject_enrolled
FROM combined c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t
  WHERE t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0
)
OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21
)
ORDER BY c.enrollment_range DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
    s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS dept_name,
    s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS enrolled,
    s.TOTAL_UNITS AS total_units
  FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
    AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0
),
dept_stats AS (
  SELECT
    dept_code,
    dept_name,
    AVG(enrolled) AS avg_enrolled,
    MAX(enrolled) - MIN(enrolled) AS range_enrolled,
    VAR_SAMP(enrolled) AS var_enrolled
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_code, dept_name
),
tip_min AS (
  SELECT
    t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
    MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_tip_enrolled
  FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t
  JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
    ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
  WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
    AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
),
units_avg AS (
  SELECT
    dept_code,
    AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY dept_code
),
lib_top AS (
  SELECT
    dept_code,
    SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title,
    NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_enrolled
  FROM (
    SELECT
      l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AS dept_code,
      l.SUBJECT_TITLE,
      l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
        ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC, l.SUBJECT_ID
      ) AS rn
    FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED l
    JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d
      ON l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'
      AND l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Political Science'
  ) ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  ds.dept_name,
  ds.avg_enrolled,
  ds.range_enrolled,
  ds.var_enrolled,
  tm.min_tip_enrolled,
  ua.avg_total_units,
  lt.top_subject_title,
  lt.top_enrolled
FROM dept_stats ds
LEFT JOIN tip_min tm ON ds.dept_code = tm.dept_code
LEFT JOIN units_avg ua ON ds.dept_code = ua.dept_code
LEFT JOIN lib_top lt ON ds.dept_code = lt.dept_code
WHERE (tm.min_tip_enrolled >= 0 OR ua.avg_total_units BETWEEN 1 AND 21)
ORDER BY ds.range_enrolled DESC
LIMIT 10;

       c.enrollment_range,
       c.enrollment_var,
       c.min_tip_enrolled,
       c.avg_total_units,
       c.top_subject_title,
       c.top_subject_enrolled
FROM combined c
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t
  WHERE t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0
)
OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY s
  WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE
    AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21
)
ORDER BY c.enrollment_range DESC
LIMIT 10
access_trace.normalized_sql: WITH dept_base AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'), so_stats AS (SELECT so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_range, AVG(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_avg, VARIANCE(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrollment_var FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS so JOIN dept_base AS db ON so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY so.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), tip_stats AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MIN(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_tip_enrolled FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t JOIN dept_base AS db ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), sos_stats AS (SELECT s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s JOIN dept_base AS db ON s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE), lib_top AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, l.SUBJECT_TITLE AS top_subject_title, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS top_subject_enrolled, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM `LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS l JOIN dept_base AS db ON l.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = db.DEPARTMENT_CODE), lib_top_final AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, top_subject_title, top_subject_enrolled FROM lib_top WHERE rn = 1), combined AS (SELECT db.DEPARTMENT_CODE, db.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.enrollment_range, ss.enrollment_avg, ss.enrollment_var, ts.min_tip_enrolled, sss.avg_total_units, lt.top_subject_title, lt.top_subject_enrolled FROM dept_base AS db JOIN so_stats AS ss ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN tip_stats AS ts ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ts.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN sos_stats AS sss ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE LEFT JOIN lib_top_final AS lt ON db.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lt.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.enrollment_avg, c.enrollment_range, c.enrollment_var, c.min_tip_enrolled, c.avg_total_units, c.top_subject_title, c.top_subject_enrolled FROM combined AS c WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t WHERE t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS s WHERE s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21) ORDER BY c.enrollment_range DESC LIMIT 10
